A chest quest underground in Thais: from the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, go down the Mintwallin path, cross poison fields and minotaurs and use a {item:Pick} in an underground park to reach a box with 10 {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars}.
either {item:Antidote} or {item:Destroy Field Rune}, because of the Poison Fields (recommended)
There may be a {creature:Fire Devil} drawn in by other players along the way.
{creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} hit hard for the recommended level: enter the hole with full health.
1. Going down through the Ancient Temple
Go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, **north** of Thais.
Going down two floors and heading north
Go down **two** floors and head as far **north** as you can.
Go down to the Rotworms floor
Go down to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor. Follow the path **east** and then **south** and go down the stairs.
Path east and south to the stairs

On this floor there are lots of {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}. Run across them and then cure the poison with an {item:Antidote}, or use {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field} to clear a path. Go down one more floor.
2. Minotaurs, Cyclopes and the underground park
East and north to the hole
Follow the path **east** and then **north**. Watch out for the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. Go down the hole marked with a circle on the map.
Route to the hole marked with a circle
Down there you will face a few {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}.
Follow the path around to the underground park and use the {item:Pick} at the spot shown on the map.
Where to use the Pick in the underground park
The quest chest is right **south-east** of the stairs. Open it to receive the stars.

Go up the stairs next to the chest and head back the same way: go around the park again to the hole you came down and climb up with the {item:Rope}; then cross the {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields} again and climb the same floors up to the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, north of Thais.
This maze has one-way holes (you cannot climb back up through them with a rope): do not fall into any hole that is not part of the route.
